projects.name: upliftpolicy
projects.description: Retention targeting by uplift rather than churn propensity, with Qini curves and doubly-robust policy evaluation. It surfaces the customers that contact drives away.
highlights: On a seeded synthetic book of 3,000 evaluated customers, the top 30% by uplift adds 4.47 points of retention; the top 30% by churn score loses 0.23.
Sleeping dogs are 37% of the churn-ranked contact list (336 of 900) but 4% of the uplift-ranked list (40 of 900).
Uplift from the T-learner correlates +0.638 with the true treatment effect; the churn score correlates -0.143.

projects.name: fieldextract
projects.description: Document field extraction with per-field calibrated confidence and a cost-optimal review threshold, so operations knows which fields need a human. Runs on a seeded simulated extractor.
highlights: Per-field isotonic calibration cut held-out ECE from 0.0290 to 0.0048, 6.0x lower.
Per-field cost-optimal routing costs 1.78x less than one tuned global threshold for the same 4,817 reviews.
A validated cutoff for a 1% field-error target auto-approves 43.8% of fields at a realised 0.87% error on held-out data.

projects.name: hierforecast
projects.description: Hierarchically reconciled energy demand forecasts using MinT shrinkage reconciliation, scored on pinball loss. Regional forecasts sum exactly to the national figure and the upper tail is accurate.
highlights: MinT's p95 pinball loss is 14.3% lower than bottom-up across 17 nodes over 200 days of synthetic demand.
Independent forecasts disagreed by up to 612 MW; after reconciliation the gap is floating-point round-off.
A seasonal-naive baseline is always reported: national RMSE 894.7 MW versus 456.4 MW for the model.

projects.name: injectbench
projects.description: Prompt-injection evaluation harness that reports attack success rate per attack class with confidence intervals. An ablation shows which guardrail layers actually reduce it.
highlights: Full-stack aggregate attack success rate is 10.8% [9.5%, 12.2%], against 87.6% undefended, over 2,000 seeded trials.
The worst class, roleplay framing, stays at 46.5%, 4.3x the aggregate that a single blocked-rate number would hide.
The provenance tagger flipped 0 of 2,000 trials while adding 11 ms, so it is flagged as redundant.

projects.name: hnswops
projects.description: An HNSW approximate-nearest-neighbor index written from scratch in Rust, with memory-mapped snapshots, online recall monitoring and zero-downtime re-embedding migration.
highlights: Live queries are sampled and replayed as brute-force shadow queries to feed a sliding-window recall estimate with efSearch autotuning.
Re-embedding migration uses dual-write, a resumable backfill, a verification gate and lossless rollback, including a change of vector dimension.
Checksummed, versioned snapshots are memory-mapped at load, with atomic publish and verified rollback.

projects.name: huntql
projects.description: A pipe-based threat-hunting query language for Zeek logs with a typed planner, a streaming executor and beaconing detection via FFT autocorrelation.
highlights: The beacon operator scores connection periodicity from inter-arrival jitter and FFT autocorrelation.
Four built-in hunting operators: stack, rare, first_seen and beacon.
Planner rewrites such as sort-plus-head fused to bounded top-k, with a line-coverage gate of 85% or higher.

projects.name: binscope
projects.description: A Rust static triage tool for ELF, Mach-O and PE binaries covering sections, entropy, imports, strings, capability rules and ssdeep/TLSH fuzzy hashes.
highlights: ssdeep and TLSH output matches the reference tools byte for byte.
34 built-in YAML capability rules report the evidence behind every match.
Similarity clustering uses single linkage on TLSH distance or ssdeep score, with exact candidate pruning.

projects.name: fwaudit
projects.description: Offline firmware image auditor for embedded Linux and IoT. It extracts containers in memory under safety limits and reports hardcoded credentials, private keys, weak services and outdated components.
highlights: 30 audit rules with a deterministic JSON report that a CI job can gate on.
Components are matched against a pinned offline CVE subset of 20 CVEs with a SHA-256 integrity pin.
Extraction writes nothing to disk and is bounded against path traversal and decompression bombs.

projects.name: solsentry
projects.description: A static security analyzer for Solidity that builds control-flow graphs from the solc compact JSON AST and reports eight smart-contract bug classes as text, JSON or SARIF.
highlights: Eight detectors, including reentrancy, unprotected selfdestruct and integer overflow, built on dominator, def-use and taint analyses.
Outputs SARIF 2.1.0 for code-scanning UIs, with a precision/recall evaluation harness.
Pure Python 3.12 with no runtime dependencies, checked by mypy --strict and 146 tests.
